theme: Reading & Speaking Fluency, 10 Questions Speaking Chain & Team Challenge
japaneseTheme: 読む・話す・もう一度！流暢さトレーニング (Yomu, hanasu, mō ichido! Ryūchōsa torēningu)
subtitle: Put theory into rapid execution with action choice drills, rapid date & time recognition, and dual reading passages
description: Intensive verbal fluency practice drilling actions in context, colour-noun combinations (赤いりんご, 青いそら), 10 calendar dates and 10 clock times, two parallel mini readings (Yuki vs Aki), a 10-question speaking chain, and the final 10-point team challenge.
goals: Rapidly pick the natural action verb for everyday nouns (本を読みます, 音楽を聞きます, テレビを見ます)
Pronounce Japanese colors and adjectives without hesitation (赤いりんご, 青いそら, 白いくも, 黒いかばん)
Instantly read calendar dates (9/1, 9/4, 9/6, 9/8, 9/10) and odd minutes (1:01, 2:03, 4:04, 7:06)
Read and comprehend two full story passages: Passage A (ゆき) & Passage B (あき)
Answer all 10 questions in the interactive Speaking Chain
keyHighlights: Fluency Rule: Try reading the kanji first without checking the furigana hint! Train your eyes to recognize whole characters instantaneously.
Color + Noun Combinations: Colors that end in い modify nouns directly: 赤いりんご (red apple), 青いそら (blue sky), 白いくも (white cloud), 黒いかばん (black bag)!

Dual Passage Timeline: Story A takes place on Friday, Sept 4th at 9 AM with Yuki in the park; Story B takes place on Thursday, Sept 10th at 3-5 PM with Aki listening to music and writing in his white bag!

grammarNotes.title: Colour Adjectives: い vs の
grammarNotes.explanation: Native Japanese colour terms directly modify nouns using their final い (赤い本, 青いそら, 白いねこ, 黒い犬). Loanword colours (ピンク, オレンジ, グレー) are nouns and require the particle の (ピンクの花, オレンジのみかん, グレーの車).

grammarNotes.title: Subject Particle が with 'だれ' (Who)
grammarNotes.explanation: When asking who performs an action with 'だれが', the answer must also use 'が' to identify the actor.

examples.japanese: だれが名前を書きますか？
examples.reading: だれがなまえをかきますか？ (dare ga namae o kakimasu ka?)

examples.reading: せんせいがかきます (sensei ga kakimasu)

grammarNotes.title: Time Marker に in Compound Sentences
grammarNotes.explanation: Specific points in time require に. When multiple activities happen in a sequence, each timestamp takes に.

readingPassages.title: Passage A: ゆきの金曜日 (Yuki's Friday Morning)
readingPassages.text: 九月四日は金曜日です。ゆきは午前九時に公園へ行きます。公園であきと話します。それから、青い本を読みます。午前十時に家へ帰ります。
readingPassages.translation: September 4th is Friday. Yuki goes to the park at 9:00 AM. In the park, she talks with Aki. After that, she reads a blue book. At 10:00 AM, she returns home.

questions.q: 何月何日ですか？ (Nan-gatsu nan-nichi desu ka? / What date is it?)
questions.a: 九月四日（くがつ よっか / kugatsu yokka）です。(Sep 4)

questions.q: 何曜日ですか？ (Nan-yōbi desu ka? / What day of the week is it?)
questions.a: 金曜日（きんようび / kinyōbi）です。(Friday)

questions.q: ゆきは何時に公園へ行きますか？ (Yuki wa nan-ji ni kōen e ikimasu ka? / What time does Yuki go to the park?)
questions.a: 午前九時（ごぜん くじ / gozen kuji）です。(9:00 AM)

questions.q: 公園でだれと話しますか？ (Kōen de dare to hanashimasu ka? / Who does she talk with in the park?)
questions.a: あきと話します。(Aki to hanashimasu. / Talks with Aki.)

questions.q: 本は何色ですか？ (Hon wa nani-iro desu ka? / What color is the book?)
questions.a: 青（あおい本 / aoi hon）です。(Blue book)

readingPassages.romaji: Kugatsu yokka wa kinyoubi desu. Yuki wa gozen kuji ni kouen e ikimasu. Kouen de Aki to hanashimasu. Sorekara, aoi hon o yomimasu. Gozen juuji ni ie e kaerimasu.

readingPassages.title: Passage B: あきの木曜日 (Aki's Thursday Afternoon)
readingPassages.text: 九月十日は木曜日です。あきは午後三時に家でテレビを見ます。午後四時に音楽を聞きます。白いかばんに名前を書きます。午後五時にゆきと話します。
readingPassages.translation: September 10th is Thursday. Aki watches TV at home at 3:00 PM. At 4:00 PM he listens to music. He writes his name on a white bag. At 5:00 PM he talks with Yuki.

questions.q: 何月何日ですか？ (Nan-gatsu nan-nichi desu ka? / What date is it?)
questions.a: 九月十日（くがつ とおか / kugatsu tōka）です。(Sep 10)

questions.q: 何曜日ですか？ (Nan-yōbi desu ka? / What day of the week is it?)
questions.a: 木曜日（もくようび / mokuyōbi）です。(Thursday)

questions.q: あきは午後三時にどこでテレビを見ますか？ (Aki wa gogo sanji ni doko de terebi o mimasu ka? / Where does Aki watch TV at 3:00 PM?)
questions.a: 家（いえ / ie）で見ます。(At home)

questions.q: 午後四時に何をしますか？ (Gogo yoji ni nani o shimasu ka? / What does Aki do at 4:00 PM?)
questions.a: 音楽を聞きます。(Ongaku o kikimasu. / Listens to music)

questions.q: かばんは何色ですか？ (Kaban wa nani-iro desu ka? / What color is the bag?)
questions.a: 白（しろいかばん / shiroi kaban）です。(White bag)

readingPassages.romaji: Kugatsu tooka wa mokuyoubi desu. Aki wa gogo sanji ni ie de terebi o mimasu. Gogo yoji ni ongaku o kikimasu. Shiroi kaban ni namae o kakimasu. Gogo goji ni Yuki to hanashimasu.

practiceQuiz.question: In Passage A, what time does Yuki return home?
options: 午前九時 (ごぜんくじ / gozen kuji - 9:00 AM)
午前十時 (ごぜんじゅうじ / gozen jūji - 10:00 AM)
午後三時 (ごごさんじ / gogo sanji - 3:00 PM)
午後五時 (ごごごじ / gogo goji - 5:00 PM)
practiceQuiz.correct: 午前十時 (ごぜんじゅうじ / gozen jūji - 10:00 AM)
practiceQuiz.explanation: Passage A states: 午前十時に家へ帰ります (Returns home at 10:00 AM).

practiceQuiz.question: In Passage B, what does Aki do at 4:00 PM (午後四時 / gogo yoji)?
options: テレビを見ます (terebi o mimasu - watches TV)
音楽を聞きます (ongaku o kikimasu - listens to music)
本を読みます (hon o yomimasu - reads a book)
公園へ行きます (kōen e ikimasu - goes to the park)
practiceQuiz.correct: 音楽を聞きます (ongaku o kikimasu - listens to music)
practiceQuiz.explanation: Passage B states: 午後四時に音楽を聞きます (Listens to music at 4:00 PM).

practiceQuiz.question: Which verb naturally pairs with 音楽 (おんがく / ongaku - music)?
options: 見ます (みます / mimasu - watch)
聞きます (ききます / kikimasu - listen)
書きます (かきます / kakimasu - write)
行きます (いきます / ikimasu - go)
practiceQuiz.correct: 聞きます (ききます / kikimasu - listen)
practiceQuiz.explanation: 音楽を聞きます (ongaku o kikimasu) means to listen to music.

practiceQuiz.question: How do you read 7:06 in Japanese?
options: ななじ ろくふん (nanaji rokufun)
しちじ ろっぷん (shichiji roppun)
ななじ ろっぷん (nanaji roppun)
しちじ ろくふん (shichiji rokufun)
practiceQuiz.correct: しちじ ろっぷん (shichiji roppun)
practiceQuiz.explanation: 7 o'clock is しちじ (shichiji) and 6 minutes uses sokuon: ろっぷん (roppun).

slides.jpTitle: 表紙：日本語 Class 454
slides.summary: Intensive reading and speaking drill reviewing actions, colours, dates, and times.
bullets: Class: Nikki JP Class 454
Core Focus: Actions (見る, 聞く, 話す, 読む, 書く, 行く), Colours (赤, 青, 白, 黒, ピンク, オレンジ, グレー), Dates & Time
Format: Rapid reading, partner dialogue, and classroom speaking chains.
slides.highlight: Language fluency comes from speaking in full sentences without hesitation.

slides.title: Today's Lesson Map & Classroom Rules
blocks: Another student repeats the full sentence.
Use the reading clue only when needed.
slides.jpTitle: 本日のレッスンプランとルール
slides.summary: Six sequential milestones for Class 454.
bullets: 1. 動作を読む (Read actions)
2. 色を言う (Say colours)
3. 日付を読む (Read calendar dates)
4. 時間を言う (State clock times)
5. Mini Reading (Readings A & B)
6. Speaking Chain (10 classroom questions)
Class rule: One student answers first, then partner responds immediately.
slides.highlight: Speed and pronunciation accuracy are the focus of this session.
